summary: {person} explains in public who will decide the applications waiting on regulators' desks.
realLife: Carter told the public that the independent NRC could decide pending plant licenses individually.
gates: A license application is pending before an independent regulator.
weights: Public requests for executive action favor explaining who has authority to decide.
inGame: needs: who decides a license application and when.

turns.what: The regulator pauses a group of pending applications together.
turns.pulledBy: A common review requirement applies to every application in the group.
turns.writesBack: The docket records the joint hold and its basis.

turns.what: A single application goes forward while others await evidence.
turns.pulledBy: Only one applicant has supplied the missing records.
turns.writesBack: The docket separates that hearing from the held applications.
